summary.intent: Close the race in which two goroutines both see an addrConn as Idle and start parallel connection attempts (grpc-go#7365, per the supplied PR text): connect() and updateAddrs() now hand ac.mu directly to resetTransportAndUnlock() so the Idle check and the transition to Connecting share one critical section.
summary.issue_fit: Met against the supplied spec (PR text for grpc-go#7365); no issue was fetched offline, so the spec's quoted issue thread was the intent source. The 100000-run flake-free claim is a supporting assertion that could not be repeated here.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of clientconn.go reviewed (single file, +6/-7, 4 commits); callers of resetTransportAndUnlock, addrConn.onClose, http2Client.GracefulClose and the balancer-wrapper serializer read. Three concurrency safety premises were verified in one initial batch and hold; the verifier's return needed an encoding-only repair (two JSON objects, second used verbatim). No tests were run: the changed code has no changed tests, and the xDS flake test named in the spec is outside the focused-test allowance. Uncommitted changes: none.

observations.fact: The change adds no regression test for the connect()/connect() race; the only evidence is the author's reported 100000-run Test/AuthorityRevive loop.
observations.evidence: git diff main...review-head touches only clientconn.go; spec-pr-7390/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes".

requirements.source: spec-pr-7390/"no concurrent requests are able to start once caller of resetTransport does some validation"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:914-922 keeps ac.mu held from the Idle check into resetTransportAndUnlock, which sets Connecting (clientconn.go:1261) before unlocking; verifier ruled premise-1 holds

requirements.source: spec-pr-7390/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes for 100000 attempts"
requirements.evidence: Author-reported measurement; the xDS test and repeated-run harness are outside the offline focused-test allowance, and nothing material depends on it beyond the traced mechanism

tasks.premise: connect() cannot let two goroutines both pass the Idle check and start attempts: ac.mu is held from the Idle check until resetTransportAndUnlock sets Connecting.
updateAddrs returning with ac.mu held by the spawned goroutine cannot deadlock: the deferred GracefulClose/onClose only waits for resetTransportAndUnlock to release ac.mu.
Every path through resetTransportAndUnlock releases ac.mu exactly once before blocking or returning.
